title: Epilogue
summary: EP'ILOGUE, noun ep'ilog. [Latin epilogus, from Gr. conclusion; to conclude; to speak.] 1. In oratory, a conclusion; the closing part of a discourse, in which the principal matters are recapitulated. 2

inlines.v: EP'ILOGUE, noun ep'ilog. [Latin epilogus, from Gr. conclusion; to conclude; to speak.] 1. In oratory, a conclusion; the closing part of a discourse, in which the principal matters are recapitulated. 2. In the drama, a speech or short poem addressed to the spectators by one of the actors, after the conclusion of the play.
